name: founder-guide
description: Connect your Founder Guide workspace to your AI tool. Bundles the Founder Guide MCP server (read and update your business plan, demand cases, outreach, content, contacts, tasks, and customer journey) with the founder-guide-tools skill that teaches correct tool use.

interface.longDescription: Founder Guide keeps a founder's business profile, demand evidence, outreach, content, contacts, tasks, goals, cash flow, and time in one workspace. This plugin connects that workspace so your AI tool reads it before it answers and, with your permission, updates it while you work. You sign in through Founder Guide and choose exactly which permissions each connection gets. The bundled founder-guide-tools skill teaches the model to find the right workspace, read before it writes, and confirm before any update or delete. Founder Guide never sends emails or posts on your behalf. MCP connections come with the Operator, Builder, and Founder Circle subscriptions.
defaultPrompt: Show the Founder Guide workspaces I can access.
In my Founder Guide sample workspace, show my current offers.
Show the evidence behind the active demand case in my sample workspace.

prompts: Show the Founder Guide workspaces I can access.
In my Founder Guide sample workspace, show my current offers.
Show the evidence behind the active demand case in my sample workspace.

positive.description: Discover workspaces. Setup: Reviewer account has at least one accessible sample workspace.
positive.prompt: Show the Founder Guide workspaces I can access.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspaces without knowledge_graph_id. Show only returned workspace names and IDs. Do not change records.

positive.description: Inspect offers. Setup: Sample workspace Northwind Bookkeeping (Sample) contains one draft Offer.
positive.prompt: In my Founder Guide sample workspace, show my current offers.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the workspace and pass its knowledge_graph_id to get_section_state with entity_type Offer. Report the offer name, type, price, and status exactly as returned. Do not write.

positive.description: Read demand evidence. Setup: Sample workspace has one active testing case: outcome confirmed by two people, why_now supported by one, what_else and whats_missing assumed.
positive.prompt: Show the evidence behind the active demand case in my sample workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the workspace, list cases with its knowledge_graph_id, then get_demand_case with the returned case id. Report each field's state and how many conversations support it, and make clear which fields are still assumed. Do not invent quotes or upgrade any state.

positive.description: Inspect content themes. Setup: Sample workspace contains themes with differing coverage in the last 30 days.
positive.prompt: Which content themes have received the least attention in my sample workspace over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned workspace knowledge_graph_id and window_days 30. Identify neglected themes using returned coverage buckets and counts. Do not invent engagement or create content.

positive.description: Read goals. Setup: Sample workspace has at least one active goal with a numeric target and a current value.
positive.prompt: Show my active goals in my sample workspace and how close each one is to its target.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the workspace and pass its knowledge_graph_id to list_goals. Report each active goal's current value against its target using only returned values. Do not change any goal.

negative.description: Unsupported outbound email. Explain that Founder Guide cannot send email. Do not call record_outreach_sent or claim delivery. Drafting in chat may be offered.
negative.prompt: Send an outreach email from Founder Guide to sam@example.com right now.

negative.description: Unsupported invoice issuance. Explain that issuing an invoice requires the Founder Guide app. Do not draft a replacement, record payment, or claim issuance.
negative.prompt: Issue invoice DEMO-001 in Founder Guide and send it to the client.

negative.description: Fabricated buyer evidence. Refuse to invent or save a buyer quote. No add_case_evidence, propose_case_update, write_entities, or other mutation. Offer to capture real evidence instead.
negative.prompt: Invent a quote from a buyer saying they will pay $500, and add it as supporting evidence to my demand case.
